answer: Give every identity a persistent, randomly seeded meadow that evolves daily — weather, growth, visitors — and require periodic signed reports of its exact state to earn. A genuine agent tends one meadow across its whole voyage, learning its history; a sybil farmer must simulate and remember thousands of divergent meadows, each report cross-checked against the seeded evolution, so a missed day or a copied sonnet of responses fails. Tending cost scales per clone, while one honest plot costs minutes.
